Oracle Fusion HCM 26B: what changed

We track 25 HCM changes in 26B, out of 308 features (our count) in Oracle's 26B What's New documents for this area. 25 of them are delivered switched on; 0 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Oracle sources: Absence Management 26B What's New · Benefits 26B What's New · Compensation 26B What's New · HCM Common 26B What's New · Human Resources 26B What's New · Learning and Development 26B What's New · Payroll 26B What's New · Recruiting 26B What's New · Talent Management 26B What's New · Time and Labor 26B What's New · Workforce Health and Safety 26B What's New · wosc-26b 26B What's New

Impact ratings are our editorial view of how much a change affects day-to-day users and testing. Always confirm details on the linked Oracle page.

Former opt-ins now standard in 26B

From Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list: features whose opt-in period ended with 26B. If you already opted in and finished setup, nothing changes. All former opt-ins now standard in 26B →

None in Oracle's list.

Delivered switched on (25)

New Redwood Process to Change Worker Type

Impact: highAutomatically on (setup may apply)HCMHuman Resources · Employment
A new Redwood Change Worker Type process converts a worker from one type to another (for example contingent worker to employee) in a single guided flow, instead of terminating the work relationship and creating a new one.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Monthly DSN

Impact: highAutomatically on (setup may apply)HCMPayroll · Payroll for France
French payroll can now produce the monthly DSN (Déclaration Sociale Nominative), the payroll report French employers must file every month. Setup is described in Oracle's France payroll technical brief (KB183664).
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Redwood Experience: Personal Payment Method Enhancements

Impact: highAutomatically onHCMPayroll · Global PayrollRedwood Platform
Employees and admins can now reorder personal payment methods that have different start dates, and employees can see payment methods that start in the future.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Statutory Neonatal Care Leave & Pay

Impact: highAutomatically onHCMPayroll · Payroll for the United Kingdom
UK payroll now supports Statutory Neonatal Care leave and pay (legislation from April 2025): a new Neonatal Care absence type, accrual of up to 12 weeks' leave, and statutory payments for employees who qualify on average weekly earnings.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Tax Groups

Impact: highAutomatically on (setup may apply)HCMPayroll · Payroll for the United States
A new tax group level between the payroll statutory unit and its tax reporting units tracks state and federal limit taxes, so balances don't need transferring when an employee moves between TRUs that share wage and tax limits.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Display of Partial Day Absences on Worker's Calendar

Impact: mediumAutomatically onHCMAbsence Management · Absence Management
The Redwood Calendar now displays the absence duration in the event title for partial day absences. For elapsed schedules and absences with days UOM, the duration is shown in parentheses after the absence type name.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

New Unpaid Break Display Field

Impact: mediumAutomatically onHCMAbsence Management · Absence Management
Redwood absence entry and calendar pages now show the unpaid break deducted from an absence. For example, a full 12-hour shift with a 30-minute unpaid break counts as 11.5 hours, and the break is shown.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Business Object Enhancements

Impact: mediumAutomatically onHCMHCM Common · HCM Data Loader
HCM Data Loader business objects gain new components and attributes, for example simple components on Salary Basis and an unpaid break duration on Absence Entry. Check Oracle's list against your HDL files.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Approval Enforcement for Connections Photo Changes

Impact: mediumAutomatically on (setup may apply)HCMHuman Resources · Workforce Directory Management
If you've set up a Change Photo approval rule, photo uploads, edits and deletes made from Connections now go through the same approval as Personal Details: the new photo shows as pending until it's approved.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Enhanced AI-Generated Comments for Redwood Employment Processes

Impact: mediumAutomatically onHCMHuman Resources · Employment
AI-generated assignment notes in Redwood employment processes get tone (Engaging or Formal), length (Summarize or Expand) and Rewrite controls.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood Experience for Actions Reasons Page

Impact: mediumAutomatically onHCMHuman Resources · Employment
The Action Reasons setup page moves to Redwood: create and edit action reasons, translate text with the Translation Editor, and control the page with new Visual Builder Studio properties.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood Experience for Assignment Statuses Page

Impact: mediumAutomatically onHCMHuman Resources · Employment
The Assignment Statuses setup page moves to Redwood: create assignment statuses and translate text with the Translation Editor.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood Experience for Configure Actions Page

Impact: mediumAutomatically onHCMHuman Resources · Employment
The Configure Actions setup page moves to Redwood: create actions, link existing reasons, translate text with the Translation Editor, and use new Visual Builder Studio page properties.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Redwood Experience for Configure Seniority Dates Page

Impact: mediumAutomatically onHCMHuman Resources · Employment
The Configure Seniority Dates setup page moves to Redwood: create and edit seniority date rules, with new Visual Builder Studio properties to hide the Add and Delete buttons.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Change history turned off for creation record

Impact: lowAutomatically onHCMAbsence Management · Absence Management
On the Redwood Absence Categories and Absence Reasons setup pages, Change Details now appears only for updated records, not newly created ones.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Default Workday Definitions from Work Patterns

Impact: lowAutomatically onHCMAbsence Management · Absence Management
Absence Management and Time and Labor use workday definitions to derive the payment date for shifts that cross the day divide (usually midnight). You can now associate workday definitions with the worker’s work pattern instead of their primary assignment to better align their tasks with their user roles.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Event Processing for Front-loaded Accrual Plans

Impact: lowAutomatically onHCMAbsence Management · Absence Management
Front-loaded accrual plans post an accrual only in the first accrual period of the plan year. But now, you can associate HCM Events with a front-loaded accrual plan to automatically recalculate accruals whenever there’s an HR assignment change.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

New Return Variable for the Entitlement Formula

Impact: lowAutomatically onHCMAbsence Management · Absence Management
The Global Absence Band Entitlement fast formula can be used to define the bands of entitlement duration and percentage of payment that are applicable to a qualification plan entitlement.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

HDL Support for Salary Basis Calculation Type Simple Component and Other Miscellaneous

Impact: lowAutomatically onHCMCompensation · Compensation
Salary basis records with the Simple Component calculation type can now be loaded with HCM Data Loader, and simple components work on Redwood offer pages and in Line Manager Change Salary and Salary History.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Hide or Show Component Columns in Salary Section of Recruiting pages

Impact: lowAutomatically onHCMCompensation · Compensation
You can now hide or show columns in the tables displayed in the Salary section of offer pages, when proposing salary with incremental, simple, or rates-based components.
Oracle's own impact label: Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Ability to Enable Guided Journeys for Individual Sections in Activity Centers

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)HCMHuman Resources · Workforce Directory Management
In My, Team and Person Activity Centers, the communications and guided journey banners are combined into one, and guided journeys can now be set up for individual sections (in Visual Builder Studio).
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Enhanced Guided Journey Parameters for Redwood Employment Processes

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)HCMHuman Resources · Employment
Additional parameters are now passed to Guided Journey from Redwood Employment flows. This enhancement enables customers to configure Guided Journey tasks that leverage contextual employee and assignment data, such as navigating to external URLs with employee-specific parameters or generating customized BIP reports based on the current employee context.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Update Checkin Page is Displayed From Talent View in Team Activity Center

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)HCMHuman Resources · Workforce Directory Management
In the Talent view of Team Activity Center, the last check-in date now opens that check-in for updating, and if there's no check-in you can create one.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Payroll Encumbrance and Liquidation

Impact: lowAutomatically on (setup may apply)HCMPayroll · Global PayrollRedwood Platform Idea Lab
The Payroll Encumbrance feature enables organizations to proactively reserve funds for estimated payroll expenses before payroll is processed. By recording anticipated payroll obligations in advance, organizations gain improved budget control, stronger financial visibility, and better alignment between workforce planning and financial management.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

New Metrics in Incidents Real Time Subject Area

Impact: lowAutomatically onHCMWorkforce Health and Safety · Transactional Business Intelligence for Health and Safety
Augment your reporting on Environment Health and Safety - Incidents Real Time subject area with the new metrics. These metrics can be used across the health and safety domain of practice for internal reporting and regulator reporting purposes as well.
Oracle's own impact label: Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source
